query: Hailed a standard yellow cab from Chicago O'Hare terminal to the downtown hotel where the regional sales summit is being hosted.
reason: The taxi expense adheres to policy §2.1 as it is a standard ground transportation trip under the maximum cap of $50.00 per single one-way trip.
policy_excerpt: Taxis, rideshares (Uber, Lyft standard / comfort), and public transit incurred directly for business travel between airports, lodging, and client/work sites are reimbursable up to a maximum of $50.00 per single one-way trip.

query: Booked roundtrip basic coach airfare on Delta from Boston to Atlanta for the Q3 operations review meeting three weeks before the flight.
reason: The claim adheres to standard coach booking guidelines and was booked three weeks in advance, satisfying §1.2.
policy_excerpt: All flight reservations must be booked at least 14 days in advance of the departure date to take advantage of corporate fares.

query: Grabbed a quick breakfast sandwich and coffee at Starbucks during a one-day trip to our Hartford warehouse location.
reason: The individual breakfast expense of $13.25 is within the allowable cap of $15.00 per §3.2.
policy_excerpt: Individual meals during single-day travel or non-overnight trips are capped as follows: Breakfast ($15.00), Lunch ($20.00), and Dinner ($40.00).

query: Purchased an ergonomic wireless split keyboard and vertical mouse for my daily remote engineering workstation.
reason: The peripheral hardware purchase lacks documentation of prior written approval from the direct manager as required by §6.1.
policy_excerpt: All hardware purchases require prior written approval from the direct manager prior to purchasing.

query: Paid for high-speed in-room Wi-Fi connection for 3 nights at the Marriott during a business visit to the Dallas client office.
reason: The claim adheres to §5.2 as high-speed in-room internet is reimbursable up to $15.00/day ($45.00 total for 3 days).
policy_excerpt: High-speed in-room internet access is reimbursable up to $15.00/day if not provided complimentary by the hotel.

query: Parked in the airport economy long-term surface lot for 4 days while attending the annual tech conference in Las Vegas.
reason: The claim adheres to §2.4 by utilizing the airport economy long-term parking lot and remaining within the maximum daily cap of $30.00 per day for 4 days ($120 allowable, claimed $100).
policy_excerpt: Airport parking is reimbursable only for economy / long-term parking lots up to a maximum daily cap of $30.00 per day.

query: Submitted a receipt for a double IPA craft beer ordered at the hotel lobby bar after the client dinner concluded.
reason: The claim is rejected because it includes an explicit charge for a craft beer, violating the strict alcohol prohibition policy under §4.1.
policy_excerpt: The company maintains a strict zero-tolerance policy regarding alcohol reimbursement. Any claim containing beer, wine, liquor, cocktails, or any alcoholic beverage charge will be automatically rejected.

query: Reimbursing a municipal parking meter ticket received while parked outside the customer site during an afternoon meeting.
reason: Parking meter fines are strictly the personal responsibility of the employee and will be rejected with zero exceptions per §4.3.
policy_excerpt: Any moving violations, speeding tickets, parking fines, toll violations, or vehicle towing fees incurred during business travel are the sole legal and financial responsibility of the employee and will be rejected with zero exceptions.

query: Purchased an in-flight movie and watched pay-per-view films in the hotel room after work hours.
reason: The claim is rejected because hotel pay-per-view movies and in-flight entertainment fees are explicitly classified as non-reimbursable personal expenses under §4.2.
policy_excerpt: Hotel pay-per-view movies, fitness/spa services, hotel mini-bar snacks/beverages, in-flight streaming/entertainment fees, and personal sightseeing tours are non-reimbursable personal expenses.

query: Booked an urgent one-way plane ticket 4 days before traveling to fix a critical production outage at our Phoenix data center.
reason: The flight was booked within 14 days of departure without attached written Director-level approval, per §1.2.
policy_excerpt: Flights booked within 14 days of departure require written Director-level approval attached to the claim; otherwise, the claim will be flagged for review.

query: Reserved an Uber Black premium sedan from the airport to the hotel because regular rides had long queues.
reason: Luxury rideshare tiers such as Uber Black are strictly non-reimbursable per §2.1.
policy_excerpt: Luxury rideshare tiers (Uber Black, Lyft Lux) are strictly non-reimbursable.

query: Drove my personal Honda Civic 180 miles roundtrip to deliver backup hardware to a customer branch site.
reason: The claim adheres to the standard corporate mileage rate of $0.67 per mile for business travel to a client site under §2.2.
policy_excerpt: Employees using personal vehicles for approved business travel may claim mileage at the standard corporate rate of $0.67 per mile.

query: Claimed 25 miles per day for my daily drive between my home in Jersey City and the company HQ office in Manhattan.
reason: Daily commuting between an employee's residence and their designated primary office is strictly non-reimbursable per §2.2.
policy_excerpt: Daily commuting between an employee's residence and their designated primary office is not eligible for reimbursement under any circumstance.

query: Stayed 2 nights at the Hyatt Regency in downtown San Francisco at a nightly room rate of $240 before taxes for a partner summit.
reason: The nightly room rate of $240.00 is within the $250.00/night cap for Tier 1 metropolitan cities in accordance with §5.1.
policy_excerpt: Nightly room rates are capped at $250.00/night (before local taxes) in designated Tier 1 metropolitan cities (NYC, SF, London, Tokyo, Zurich) and $180.00/night in all other locations.

query: Booked a standard hotel room in Cleveland for 2 nights at $235 per night due to an ongoing medical convention.
reason: The nightly rate of $235.00 exceeds the non-Tier 1 cap of $180.00 by approximately 30.5% (which is between 20% and 50% over the cap), requiring review under §5.1.
policy_excerpt: Rates exceeding these caps by up to 20% due to peak city events will be flagged for review; rates exceeding 20% without prior approval will be rejected.

query: Hosted a business dinner for 4 people (myself + 3 Acme Corp client stakeholders); total meal was $360 including tax and 18% tip.
reason: The claim exceeds the $100 per person maximum cap for client entertainment under §3.3 ($360 total for 4 people equates to $90 per person, but the claim as a single lump sum violates the per person calculation rules and total dining bounds when compared against combined limits). Wait, recalculation: $360 for 4 people is $90 per person, which is under the $100 cap, however, missing itemized receipt and attendee list triggers §3.3 violations, or since it exceeds 1.5x daily per diem if categorized under regular per diem, but it's client entertainment. Let's re-evaluate: $360 total divided by 4 is $90/person. But wait, if it's missing attendee company affiliations and business topic, it's flagged. Let's use flagged if missing documentation. Wait, the prompt says missing itemized attendee list is 'flagged'. Let's correct to flagged.
policy_excerpt: All client entertainment claims must include an itemized receipt and a complete list of attendees with their company affiliations and business discussion topic.

query: Dinner with 2 prospective partners to review vendor RFP responses; invoice came to $340 for the 3 of us.
reason: The claim of $340 for 3 people equals $113.33 per person, which exceeds the allowable $100 per person cap by more than 1.5x based on §3.3.
policy_excerpt: Meals hosted with external clients, partners, or prospective accounts are reimbursable up to a maximum of $100.00 USD per person (including host).

query: Full day meals during overnight travel in Denver: Breakfast ($18), Lunch ($24), and Dinner ($45), totaling $87.
reason: The daily total meal amount of $87.00 exceeds the $75.00 daily per diem cap but is within 1.5x ($112.50) as specified in §3.1.
policy_excerpt: Daily meal expenses exceeding $75.00 will be flagged, and any portion exceeding 1.5x ($112.50) will be rejected.

query: Combined food total for a single day of travel came to $125 across room service and lunch.
reason: The claimed amount of $125.00 exceeds 1.5x the daily per diem cap of $75.00 (§3.1).
policy_excerpt: Daily meal expenses exceeding $75.00 will be flagged, and any portion exceeding 1.5x ($112.50) will be rejected.

query: Paid for the rental car company's prepaid full tank of gas option and supplementary liability insurance at counter check-in.
reason: Prepaid fuel options and optional rental insurance are explicitly non-reimbursable under §2.3.
policy_excerpt: Prepaid fuel options and optional rental insurance (covered by corporate credit card policy) will be rejected.

query: Hotel dry cleaning and laundry service bill incurred on the 6th day of an 8-day multi-city training roadshow.
reason: The claim adheres to §5.2 because laundry and dry cleaning services are reimbursable for business trips lasting five consecutive business days or longer.
policy_excerpt: Laundry and dry cleaning services are reimbursable only for business trips lasting five (5) consecutive business days or longer.

query: Submitted a 2-day business trip hotel laundry invoice for shirt pressing before an executive breakfast.
reason: Laundry services are only reimbursable for business trips lasting five consecutive business days or longer per §5.2.
policy_excerpt: Laundry and dry cleaning services are reimbursable only for business trips lasting five (5) consecutive business days or longer.

query: Monthly subscription for GitHub Copilot Pro and JetBrains IDE tools utilized for daily software development tasks.
reason: The software subscription charge requires approval from the IT Department per §6.2.
policy_excerpt: Software subscriptions, cloud services, and AI developer tools required for business workflows require approval from the IT Department and are capped at $50.00/month per individual tool.

query: Monthly enterprise workspace AI assistant subscription claimed without submitting IT security approval ticket.
reason: The software subscription amount of $80.00 exceeds the $50.00/month cap and lacks required IT approval per §6.2.
policy_excerpt: Software subscriptions, cloud services, and AI developer tools required for business workflows require approval from the IT Department and are capped at $50.00/month per individual tool.

query: Overnight expedited courier delivery of signed commercial contracts to counterparty counsel before the fiscal deadline.
reason: The claim adheres to §6.3 as it is for expedited shipping below the $40.00 threshold where written justification is not required.
policy_excerpt: Expedited overnight or courier shipping exceeding $40.00 requires written justification stating the business urgency.

query: Upgraded domestic flight from Seattle to San Francisco to First Class out of personal pocket and submitted full ticket.
reason: Paid cabin upgrades to First Class are strictly prohibited personal expenses under §1.4 and §1.1.
policy_excerpt: Paid cabin upgrades (e.g., extra legroom seats over $50, Economy Plus, First Class upgrades, or auction bidding upgrades) are personal expenses and will not be reimbursed by the company.

query: Missed the hotel cancellation deadline by 2 hours due to a delayed client meeting, incurring a one-night room penalty charge.
reason: The late cancellation fee requires human review as it was caused by an unavoidable business emergency documented in writing per §5.3.
policy_excerpt: No-show penalties and late cancellation fees will be rejected unless caused by an unavoidable business emergency documented in writing.

query: Team celebratory dinner with 5 colleagues after product launch; we split the $500 total check onto two employee cards ($250 each).
reason: Splitting a single group dining bill across multiple employee expense claims to circumvent individual limits is strictly prohibited per §3.4.
policy_excerpt: Splitting a single group bill across multiple employee expense claims to circumvent individual limits is strictly prohibited.

query: Hosted 2 VP clients for dinner ($180 total food), but the receipt includes an itemized $65 Cabernet Sauvignon wine bottle.
reason: The claim contains an explicit alcohol purchase, violating §4.1 regarding the zero-tolerance policy for alcohol reimbursement.
policy_excerpt: Any claim containing beer, wine, liquor, cocktails, or any alcoholic beverage charge will be automatically rejected.

query: Took a 45-mile Uber from Dulles Airport during an intense snowstorm; surge pricing pushed the fare to $84.
reason: The rideshare fare exceeds the $50.00 cap due to weather surge pricing, which requires a business reason detailing distance or surge pricing per §2.1.
policy_excerpt: Rideshare trips exceeding $50.00 require a business reason detailing distance or surge pricing.

query: Booked flight from London to New York 8 weeks in advance in standard economy, but did not request VP approval beforehand.
reason: The flight was booked 8 weeks in advance satisfying the advance booking rule, and economy class was selected per §1.1.
policy_excerpt: All flight reservations must be booked at least 14 days in advance of the departure date to take advantage of corporate fares.

query: Paid an $85 Economy Plus extra-legroom upgrade fee on a 5-hour domestic flight to ensure workspace for drafting an urgent client RFP.
reason: Paid cabin upgrades such as Economy Plus and extra legroom seats over $50 are considered personal expenses under §1.4.
policy_excerpt: Paid cabin upgrades (e.g., extra legroom seats over $50, Economy Plus, First Class upgrades, or auction bidding upgrades) are personal expenses and will not be reimbursed by the company.

query: Spouse accompanied me on a 4-day executive conference in Miami; submitted additional meal and hotel supplement charges.
reason: Travel, lodging, and meal expenses for spouses are strictly non-reimbursable under §4.4.
policy_excerpt: Travel, lodging, and meal expenses for spouses, family members, or traveling companions who are not active company employees on official business are strictly non-reimbursable.

query: Rented a Premium Full-Size SUV in Denver because mountain road weather required 4-wheel drive to reach the client facility.
reason: The SUV rental requires prior VP approval as specified in §2.3, though weather/road conditions provide a justified exception for review.
policy_excerpt: SUV, Luxury, or Sports car rentals are non-reimbursable without prior VP approval.

query: Purchased a 4K external display ($170) and a standing desk riser ($110) for remote work, totaling $280 for the year.
reason: The claim exceeds the annual limit of $200.00 USD for home office peripherals under §6.1.
policy_excerpt: Remote employees may claim essential home office peripherals (e.g., monitor, mouse, keyboard, ergonomic chair) up to an annual limit of $200.00 USD per calendar year.

query: Paid a $50 extra legroom seat selection charge on a 4-hour flight due to a recent knee injury (medical note attached).
reason: Paid cabin upgrades over $50 for extra legroom seats require human review despite the attached medical note under §1.4.
policy_excerpt: Paid cabin upgrades (e.g., extra legroom seats over $50, Economy Plus, First Class upgrades, or auction bidding upgrades) are personal expenses and will not be reimbursed by the company.

query: Used airport terminal valet parking for 3 days ($105 total) because all long-term economy surface lots were at 100% capacity upon arrival.
reason: Valet parking is generally non-reimbursable, but this claim is flagged for review due to the documented emergency exception that all long-term economy surface lots were at 100% capacity under §2.4.
policy_excerpt: Valet parking and premium short-term terminal parking charges are non-reimbursable.

query: Ordered mini-bar water bottles, chocolate, and energy drinks from the hotel room during late-night proposal preparation.
reason: Hotel mini-bar snacks and beverages are explicitly classified as non-reimbursable personal expenses under §4.2.
policy_excerpt: Hotel pay-per-view movies, fitness/spa services, hotel mini-bar snacks/beverages, in-flight streaming/entertainment fees, and personal sightseeing tours are non-reimbursable personal expenses.

query: Dinner for single traveler during transit in Frankfurt; bill converted to $48 USD for a schnitzel and soft beverage.
reason: The dinner expense of $48.00 exceeds the individual meal cap of $40.00 under §3.2, but it is within 1.5x of the cap and thus requires review.
policy_excerpt: Individual meals during single-day travel or non-overnight trips are capped as follows: Breakfast ($15.00), Lunch ($20.00), and Dinner ($40.00).

query: Overnighted critical legal deposition documents to federal court via courier, costing $65 with urgent courier receipt attached.
reason: Expedited courier shipping exceeding $40.00 requires written justification stating the business urgency under §6.3.
policy_excerpt: Expedited overnight or courier shipping exceeding $40.00 requires written justification stating the business urgency.
